item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated police conduct during an arrest in High Street Mall in Fremantle and reviewed the Internal Affairs Unit investigation.
item.support: The Commission conducted an investigation and reviewed IAU's investigation of the incident.

item.text: The Commission formed misconduct opinions about two officers' use of force, including twisting a restrained person's finger to dislocation.
item.support: 1/C Donohoe's action in twisting the finger of a restrained person to the point of dislocation was unreasonable and excessive.

item.text: It concluded that force used to subdue the person was excessive but expressed no opinion about criminal offences.
item.support: The Commission does not express any opinion on whether it constitutes an offence.
